audit_item: A11 / M1.3 strict stage-analyzer JSON input contract

reproduction.duplicate_json: Both the current and still-callable revision-2 readers used default json.loads, accepting duplicate keys (including nested objects) and selecting the last value.
reproduction.invalid_utf8: read_text(encoding='utf-8') leaked UnicodeDecodeError instead of the analyzer ValueError contract.

change: Both analyzers use a recursive object_pairs_hook to reject duplicate JSON keys. I/O, UTF-8 and JSON syntax failures normalize to ValueError with the input path. The revision-2 compatibility analyzer also rejects non-finite/bool numerics, empty or inconsistent equity reconciliation, malformed account rows, bool/non-integer counters, and execution/risk counters exceeding policy decisions.

verification.pytest: tests/test_m13_stage_contribution_v2.py + tests/test_m13_stage_contribution_analysis.py: 37 passed, 1 skipped (symlink creation unavailable on this system)
verification.ruff: passed for both analyzers and both regression modules
verification.mypy: passed for both analyzers with --follow-imports=silent --disable-error-code=import-untyped; installed package has no py.typed marker

scope: Synthetic temporary fixtures only; no market bundle payload, ledger, Validation, Test or Holdout was opened. M1.3 remains partial until compatible E1/R1/E2 native reports exist.
